pasos: To make the marinade for the satee put in the container of an electric blender:
large onion, coarsely chopped 2 cloves of garlic
Tbs. of sugar 1 cup of soy sauce
tsp. salt 1 tsp. ground coriander for beef (or chicken) or 1 tsp. ground ginger for pork
lbs. of beef or pork tenderloin, cubed
DO NOT marinate overnight, but only for a few hours.
Pour into a large shallow dish.
To keep meat from becoming dry, roll each skewer in seasoned oil before frying.
Satee is also excellent when barbecued.
